name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.

📁 Collapsible Subfolder Tree (Accordion / Down Arrow Toggle ▼): Cloud folders and subfolders recursively parse and display with expandable/collapsible toggle controls and dedicated master checkboxes for downloading whole subfolders.
🎬 Real Video Duration Probing & Accurate Timeline Badges: Fast HTTP Range mvhd atom probing extracts real video duration; eliminates 00:00 by showing true duration, 🎬 HD FOOTAGE, or 📸 PHOTO.
📦 ZIP Packaging & Custom Destination: Choose any local destination folder with Browse button or bundle selected files into a single .ZIP archive directly.
⚡ Google Drive Folder Batch & Multi-Format Support: Seamlessly handles nested subfolders, images, and videos without missing files or undefined counts
